contest_utility_spread_accuracy_gradient.classification_evidence: Week-blocked 95% interval reaches -0.80 at the low end, the expected shape at this evaluator's resolution; no admissible closing ground. wrong_sign_resolved inadmissible (interval is mostly above zero). Split-half by season parity is positive in both halves independently (odd 2021/23/25 +8.59 points, even 2020/22/24 +2.56), so no_split_half_reliability is inadmissible; a Pearson split-half is not defined for a population gap statistic, so --reliability is omitted and the two halves are reported instead.
contest_utility_spread_accuracy_gradient.description: MEASURED ACCURACY (the only non-simulated cell in this family). Forced-pick accuracy at the frozen Tuesday opener on picks whose spread is 4.5 or less (53.92%, 829 games) minus picks whose spread is 7.5 or more (48.31%, 325 games), active weak_stack model, 2020-2025 opener evaluation. This gradient is the mechanism POL-05's star-choice cells rest on: the max-probability game in a week is the small-spread game, and a big-spread star is a pick measured below a coin flip.
contest_utility_spread_accuracy_gradient.notes: POL-05 contest utility optimizer. Week-blocked bootstrap, 20000 samples, seed 20260911, via nfl_ats.clv.week_blocked_bootstrap. Command: scripts/contest_utility_optimizer.py --gradient-only.
contest_utility_spread_accuracy_gradient.plain_summary: Our picks do much better on close games than on blowout-spread games: about 54 percent right when the line is inside a field goal, about 48 percent when it is a touchdown or more.
